models_evaluated: FDA-approved AI pneumothorax detection tool with PACS alert system

links.outcome: Radiologist report turnaround time for confirmed pneumothorax CXRs with vs without AI alerts
links.effect: Median reporting time reduced by 46% with AI integration (100 vs. 186 min, p < .001)
links.quote: Median reporting time in CXRs with radiologist-confirmed PTx was reduced by 46% in those with AI integration as compared to those without AI integration (100 vs. 186 min, p < .001).

links.outcome: AI sensitivity for pneumothorax in real-world inpatient CXRs
links.effect: Overall AUC .78, sensitivity .60, specificity .97; for moderate/large PTx AUC .93, sensitivity .89, specificity .96
links.quote: Area under ROC curve (AUC) for the AI tool was.78 with sensitivity of .60 and specificity of .97.
